title: HealthObservation
description: Canonical shape of a single normalized HealthKit / external observation as it travels from the iOS sync companion to POST /healthkit/sync. This file is the single source of truth — the TypeScript mirror (shared/models/HealthObservation.ts), the JS mirror (shared/models/HealthObservation.js), and the Swift Codable struct (apps/ios/NARTHECare/Models/HealthObservation.swift) all exist to match this schema. If they disagree, the schema wins.

sourceType.description: Transport that delivered the sample. Phase 4A only ships 'healthkit' from iOS; 'manual' is reserved for future caregiver-entered rows.

sourceRecordId.description: Stable per-sample id supplied by the source (HealthKit sample UUID) or a deterministic dedupe key when the source has none. Combined with sourceType for the ON CONFLICT (source_type, source_record_id) DO NOTHING idempotency guarantee — re-sending the same sample window is always safe.

metricType.description: One of the eight Phase 4A metric strings. Mirrors METRIC_TYPES in apps/backend/lib/health-observations.js.

value.description: Numeric measurement in the units specified by `unit`. PHI — never log.

unit.description: Canonical unit paired with `metricType`. Mirrors METRIC_UNITS in apps/backend/lib/health-observations.js so the DB never has to interpret iOS-side enums.

measuredAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the sample was taken (or the end of the range for cumulative samples). PHI — never log.

startAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 start of the range for samples that cover an interval (e.g. sleep). Absent for instant samples.

endAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 end of the range for interval samples. Absent for instant samples.

metadata.description: Optional non-PHI structured extensions only — e.g. { device: 'AppleWatch', motionContext: 'active' }. Never raw HealthKit payloads, never free-text notes, never identifiers, never timestamps the parent fields already cover.
